comment: P4 task 11, bucket four. The reference machine cannot produce this case: 0 of its 1,410 packages predate the log window (which opens 2025-11-11T00:50:40+0000), so the log-coverage bucket is empty there and this path would never be exercised. Here, `ancient` records an %INSTALLDATE% from before the earliest pacman.log line the baseline signed, so the log NEVER covered its install: it is a coverage gap for that package, not evidence against it. `tampered` changed inside the covered window with no transaction, and stays critical -- the fixture would prove nothing if everything in it were down-rated.
